Variants.Content: Widow's Hope is a coastal stronghold in the eastern part of the North facing Seal Bay. Its name carries the melancholy common to the seaside: voyagers may not always return, and bad weather and enemy ships are often seen first by those on the shore. Watchtowers, fish salts, coastal paths and sheltered bays constitute the real value of the place. The east coast of the North does not directly face the Iron Islands like the Sunset Sea side, but it still has to deal with storms, drifts and occasional visitors in the northern part of the Narrow Sea. For inland lords, Widow's Hope may be just the edge of the map; for local residents, the sea is food, roads, and the most unpredictable border.

Entry Widow's Watch If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Widow's Watch A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Widow's Watch They care about firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries that can survive the long winter. They also care about whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, they see whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
